info.name: Minted Panel /api
info.description:
HTTP surface for the Chrome extension workbench (+ document signing for the webapp).

Every response is `{ data, error, meta }`.
- Success: `data` set, `error` null
- Failure: `data` null, `error` string, HTTP status set
- List `meta` often carries `{ total, page, pageSize }`
- Rows are camelCase unless a locked snake_case key is noted

## Auth
- `Authorization: Bearer <supabase JWT>` on every data route
- User-scoped (`/api/me/*`, `/api/shared-*`): JWT only — no `x-org-id`
- Org-scoped: multi-org callers must send `x-org-id` (or `?orgId=`); single-org may omit

## Consumers
- Extension: almost everything except `/api/documents/*`
- Webapp: `/api/documents/*` only (rest is browser → Supabase RLS)
- SSN release is panel-ready; extension not wired yet

Source of truth: `src/server/api.ts` + `extensionRoutes.ts` / `providerRoutes.ts` / `documentRoutes.ts`.
Extension mirror types: minted-extension `src/shared/apiTypes.ts`.

item.name: Walkthrough · Train Acme form
item.description:

**Prerequisite (not /api):** register a global portals row via `upsert_global_portal` or SQL — see docs/api/shared-training-walkthrough.md Step 0.

Run 1 → 11 in order. JWT only; never send x-org-id. Set env `acmePortalKey` (default acme_provider_enrollment).
